name: adk-dart-agent-builder
description: Builds ADK Dart agents and workflows: LlmAgent (Agent) with Gemini, Claude, LiteLLM (OpenAI, Ollama, Groq, DeepSeek), GemmaLlm, ApigeeLlm, or LiteRtLmModel; FunctionTool, BaseTool, AgentTool, ModelConsultTool, McpToolset, OpenAPIToolset, SkillToolset, and ToolSearchToolset; ADK 2.0 Workflow DAG graphs (BaseNode, FunctionNode, AgentNode, JoinNode, WorkflowTool, NodeTool, routed edges, dynamic ctx.runNode, RequestInput HITL pause/resume); multi-agent SequentialAgent, ParallelAgent, LoopAgent, subAgents transfer, RemoteA2aAgent, and task delegation (mode: 'task'); session state, artifacts, memory, callbacks, plugins, and AgentEvaluator (pass@k, pass^k). Use when asked to create or modify an ADK Dart agent, tool, workflow, multi-agent pipeline, session/state logic, or evaluation test. Don't use for Flutter UI widgets (use flutter-adk-ui-builder) or project/CLI setup (use adk-dart-setup).
